stories.headline: PIF ends LIV Golf funding after 2026 season, Yasir Al-Rumayyan departs board
stories.summary: Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund confirmed it will stop financing LIV Golf after the 2026 season, citing the investment as 'no longer consistent' with its current strategy. PIF governor Yasir Al-Rumayyan resigned from the LIV board as the league announced an independent board and a search for new long-term investors; the decision followed more than $5 billion in Saudi outlays since 2022.

stories.headline: UAE exits OPEC, deepening Saudi-UAE rift as Gulf alliance fractures under Iran war pressure

stories.headline: Saudi Arabia navigates Strait of Hormuz closure with Yanbu oil rerouting and OPEC+ June output increase
stories.summary: Saudi Arabia rerouted the bulk of its crude exports via the Red Sea port of Yanbu as the Strait of Hormuz remained largely closed due to the US-Israel-Iran war, positioning the kingdom for significant revenue gains from elevated prices. OPEC+ producers also agreed to increase collective output by 188,000 bpd in June, with Saudi Arabia taking the largest share at 62,000 bpd.
